data.creative: Uniformed 'mice exterminator' trashes every fix, then reveals PestLab · 890882434018739
data.hook: If you just saw one of these little fuckers in your house, I guarantee there is an entire colony breeding inside your drywall right now.
data.desire: Get every mouse out of my walls for good, no more droppings or 3 a.m. scratching
data.angle: One mouse means a hidden colony; every common fix (traps, poison, steel wool, cheap plug-ins, exterminators) fails because it cannot reach inside the walls
data.belief_shift: from 'catch or kill the mouse I saw' → to 'make the whole house unlivable for them so they leave'
data.script_structure: Profane colony hook → 'here's how to actually get rid of them' → breeding stat (60 babies) → takedown of traps, poison, steel wool, cheap ultrasonics, exterminator → 'make your house a place they can't survive' → three-technology mechanism → placement + 48-hour results → safety + 140,000 homeowners → 40% off, free shipping, 90-day guarantee → tap below before sell-out
data.mechanism_reveal: Advertiser claim: 'three technologies in one device' — variable ultrasonic frequencies that shift every few seconds so mice cannot adapt, electromagnetic pulses that 'penetrate through your walls', and waves that 'scramble its ability to sense warmth and food'; runs 4-5 years so they never come back
data.proof: Presenter shown as 'LICENSED PEST CONTROL EXPERT' in a 'MICE EXTERMINATOR' shirt (credential claim); breeding stat; 48-hour result claim; collage of customers holding units with '140,000 homeowners' claim; cash shot for guarantee
data.cta: Tap below before they sell out · up to 40% off, free shipping, 90-day money back guarantee
data.why_it_works: Interpretation of execution, not measured performance: A blunt, swearing 'pro' voice makes the problem feel bigger and the old fixes feel naive, so the product arrives as the only remaining option. The long elimination list pre-handles every alternative the viewer is considering, including cheap ultrasonic plug-ins.
data.transferable_move: Open on the one visible symptom, claim it signals a hidden bigger problem, then knock out each alternative by name in one line each before naming the product as the only fix that reaches the hidden place. Do not copy an unverified 'licensed expert' label.
data.opening_visual: Man in tan work shirt with 'MICE EXTERMINATOR' patch in a kitchen holding a white PestLab unit, a mouse on the counter; red text 'HOW TO FORCE MICE OUT IN 48 HOURS' and 'LICENSED PEST CONTROL EXPERT'
data.transition_to_product: Unit is held in the opening frame; named verbally at 87.9 s 'That's what PestLab does'
data.proof_placement: Credential label in the hook; breeding stat after the problem; result claims after mechanism; 140,000 homeowners collage right before the offer; guarantee cash shot at close
